topic: Understanding Discrete Convolutions: From Filters to Features
target_audience: Undergraduate Computer Science or Engineering Students

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Sliding Window
lecture_lines: Think of filters as sliding magnifying glasses.
Scanning photographs extracts vital visual details.
Imagine our filter detecting cat ears.
animations: Create a 3x3 grid of moving dots; fade in central highlight using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifying.svg].
Transition grid to a sliding square window over data.
Flash the window red to signal data capture, displaying a captured [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/photograph.svg].

sections.title: Mathematical Core: Element-wise Product and Sum
lecture_lines: Convolution combines input and kernel matrices.
Multiply overlapping elements, then sum them up.
Flipping the kernel defines the operation formally.
Slide across grid to create new map.
One input pixel results from every shift.
animations: Display two vectors side-by-side using MathTex, positioned over a background [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Animate arrows connecting corresponding vector elements.
Show product result floating below each pair.

sections.title: Prerequisite Sync: Dot Products
lecture_lines: Dot products measure how well patterns match.
High values indicate strong pattern alignment.
Convolution acts as a powerful feature detector.
animations: Draw two vectors as arrows from origin using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg] in #FFFFFF.
Fade in the Dot Product scalar value definition.

sections.title: Real-World Application: Image Processing & CNNs
lecture_lines: Convolutional layers stack to form deep networks.
Simple edges evolve into complex object recognition.
Drones use convolutions to identify landing pads.
animations: Overlay a 3x3 filter on a pixelated image represented by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drone.svg].
Animate the filter sliding across the grid over the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drone.svg].
Flash the output feature map cells in #00FF00 based on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drone.svg] analysis.

sections.title: Summary & Reflection
lecture_lines: Convolution is scanning, multiplying, and summing.
It serves as a template matching engine.
Visualize it extracting features from data.
animations: Pulse all labels simultaneously to signal completion.
